notes: τὰ βαρύτερα read under rule 102: the article takes *the … matters* headed on the nominal and the adjective keeps a bare *weightier*; heading the phrase on *the* is the error rule 102 records JAS.1.11 correcting.
The determinerless food and virtue nouns each leave their article unrepresented, analysed uniformly (rules 23, 24).
κἀκεῖνα takes *and … the other* headed on the pronominal (rule 55), discontinuously under rule 15.
